column1: # Estonian (et) interface catalog. Columns separated by a TAB:
# Escapes: \n, \t and \\. Keep named placeholders and trailing ellipses.
# Missing entries fall back to English.
# Original translation from the meaning of this repository's English labels.
# No Microsoft Word or other product localisation was consulted or copied.
# Use short commands and plain Estonian. Keep product and format names.
# Use count-neutral labels. This catalog does not add Estonian spell checking.
# Author: @henno with Codex; MIT OR Apache-2.0, like WordCraft.

column2: A free, open-source word processor written from scratch in Rust.\nPart of the Crafting Apps from the ArtCraft team.
column3: Tasuta avatud lähtekoodiga tekstitöötlusprogramm, mis on kirjutatud Rustis.\nArtCrafti meeskonna Crafting Appsi osa.

column2:
Create an interactive outline of your document.

It's a great way to keep track of where you are or quickly move your content around.

To get started, go to the Home tab and apply Heading styles to the headings in your document.
column3:
Loo dokumendi interaktiivne liigendus.

See aitab leida oma asukohta ja sisu kiiresti ümber paigutada.

Alustamiseks ava vahekaart Avaleht ja rakenda dokumendi pealkirjadele pealkirjastiilid.

column2: Every command is available to scripts and AI agents: run `wordcraft-cli mcp` for an MCP server, or start the app with `--control <port>` for the JSON control channel.
